new.name: --kind
new.help: Create a task or an event; an event needs --start and --end. Default: task

new.name: --path
new.help: Put it under PATH, such as work/clients/, starting from the project you are in. Default: the project, or the root outside one

new.name: --parent
new.help: Put it in the object with this oid or prefix

new.name: --due
new.help: Set the due date: a date word, today+N, now+LENGTH, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM

new.name: --priority
new.help: Set the priority, 1 (highest) to 4. Default: 4

new.name: --deadline
new.help: Set the deadline, a whole day read the way --due reads one

new.name: --labels
new.help: Add labels, such as bug,urgent. Repeatable

new.name: --body
new.help: Set the body text

new.name: --start
new.help: Start the event at this time, read the way --due reads one

new.name: --end
new.help: End the event at this time, read the way --due reads one

new.name: --id
new.help: Name it with your own id, so a repeat with the same id changes it. One line, up to 200 characters; not damnit's oid

new.name: --template
new.help: Start from the template NAME: the project's .damtemplates/NAME.lua, else templates/NAME.lua beside config.lua. Each flag given replaces its value

new.name: --depends
new.help: Make it wait on the task with this oid. Repeatable

new.name: --recurrence
new.help: Repeat the task by a rule such as "every 2 weeks on mon"

new.name: --attached
new.help: Attach the task to the event with this oid

new.name: --location
new.help: Set the event's location

new.name: --estimate
new.help: Set how long the task should take: minutes, such as 5, or 5m or 2h

new.name: --focus
new.help: Mark the task to work on first on DAY, after the ones marked before it. 3 a day

new.name: --category
new.help: Give it LABEL of the label group GROUP; GROUP=none takes the group's label off. Repeatable

new.name: --preview
new.help: Show the change and write nothing

new.name: --global
new.help: Reach every task, not only the project this folder is in; a path starts from the root

new.name: --project
new.help: Work in the project at PATH, such as pns/hooks/, from any folder
